lines: Hey, you owe me a favor, so come pull me up already.
Pick me up and I'll buy the next round of snacks. Promise.
Okay, I'm down again. Anybody got a kit? Anybody at all?
Don't you dare step over me, I carried you last time.
You owe me one, remember? Time to pay up and get me up.
Ugh, my ankle's wrecked. Come help me stand, will you?
Bring the kit, please. I'm too tired to be polite.
Come on, I'm not dying on this carpet. Grab me already.
Hey, the floor is cold and I'm bored. Lift me up.
I'm not proud, I'm begging. Get over here and help me up.
You're closest, so you're stuck with me. Come on.
I'll never make fun of your singing again if you help me now.
Grab my hand, I'm not asking twice, okay?
I can't feel my left leg. Please come drag me somewhere safe.
You still owe me for that candy bar. Get me up.
Okay, go ahead and laugh, but I'm really stuck here.
Yeah, I'm hurt, and no, I'm not being dramatic. Help me.
Get me up and I'll be useful again, I promise. Just hurry.
This isn't a favor, it's a rescue. Get over here.
Please bring the kit. I'll cover you on the next fight, promise.
You always say you've got my back. Prove it, come grab me.
Come on, I know you can hear me. I'm yelling at you.
My shoulder is making a noise I really don't like. Help me up?
I'm done being brave, so please come get me now.
Pretty sure I saved your skin last time. Your turn.
Bring something sweet with the kit, I've earned it.
Leave me here and I'll haunt your snack stash forever.
Stop staring at the door and come lift me, please.
I need a shoulder here, and not the wobbly one, please.
Think of it as payback for every time I waited on you.
Hurry up, the cold is getting into my bones.
I'm trying to be cool about this, but I really need help.
Who's got a revive kit? I'll owe you a whole pizza.
A whole pizza, I swear. Just get that kit over here.
I'm bleeding and it's kind of gross, so don't look.
I dropped my pack when I fell, could you grab it too?
Ugh, I fell on my own flashlight. Please pull me up.
My flashlight's dead and so is my patience. Help.
Don't just stand there holding the kit, come kneel down.
Stay low and help me, I'll hold the door while you work.
Okay, I'll admit it, I need you. Come on.
Please don't make me crawl, I'm already in a bad mood.
I'm not stubborn, I just can't stand. Help me up already.
This is embarrassing, so hurry up and pick me up.
I'm scared out of my mind, so please hurry.
Stay close and keep talking to me while you work.
My hands are sweating so bad I can't hold the kit.
Shh, I'm trying not to scream. Come get me.
I'm not dead, just annoyed. Come on, I need a hand.
You owe me a drink and a ride home, so get over here.
Okay, you're officially on the hook for dinner after this.
Hey, you're the best with a kit. Fix me up, please.
Don't leave me in this corner, it's creepy back here.
Carry me to the stairs and I'll owe you a snack.
I always pay my debts, mostly. Get me up and I'll prove it.
Please, I'm begging. Something's dripping on my face.
A little help, please? I've got sweat in my eyes.
I'm not asking you to be a hero, just a decent teammate.
Be a hero for five minutes and grab my arm.
Sorry I'm such a mess right now. Please come help.
Did you hear that? Yeah, that's me yelling. Come get me.
Keep your voice down, but please hurry, I'm stuck.
I'm stuck under this crate and it smells like old gym socks.
Talk to me while you work, I'm not good in silence.
Quick, bring that kit before my nerve gives out.
Okay, last ask. Please kneel down and help me up.
One more favor, then we're even. I swear it, buddy.
Come on, buddy, you know I'd come get you.
You'd come get me, right? Then come on, grab my hand.
Drag me behind those lockers and I'll tell you a terrible joke.
Hurry, the crate is heavy and I'm getting squished.
Okay, I'm really asking now. Pick me up before I complain more.
Quit laughing, it's not funny, I'm really hurt.
Pull me out and I'll stop complaining. For about five minutes.
Get over here and grab my arm, that's an order.
